instruction: Query the OQMD database for Ba-Ti-O compounds (element_set=Ba,Ti,O) using limit=10. Save the total count (data_available from API metadata) and all returned entries' name/delta_e/spacegroup to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_11.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
